entry.title: Resolution 460 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR REAL PROPERTY TO BE USED BY THE OFFICE OF THE CORPORATION COUNSEL

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a three-year lease agreement with two options to extend the lease for an additional three years at an estimated monthly cost of approximately $2,600 with Joy A. San Buenaventura, Trustee of the Joy A. San Buenaventura Revocable Living Trust dated November 26, 2025, for space located at 101 Aupuni Street.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 460-26, Draft 3 & FC-126 - 03/04/26
